claude.manualEntryHint: Paste a Claude access token, or on Mac use Import from this Mac (~/.claude/.credentials.json). Manual tokens do not auto-renew.

codex.manualEntryHint: Paste tokens.access_token and tokens.account_id from ~/.codex/auth.json, or on Mac use Import from this Mac. Manual tokens do not auto-renew.

openrouter.manualEntryHint: Create or copy an OpenRouter API key from openrouter.ai → Keys and paste it here.

deepseek.manualEntryHint: Create or copy a DeepSeek API key from platform.deepseek.com → API Keys and paste it here.

moonshot.manualEntryHint: Paste your Moonshot open-platform API key (sk-...) from platform.kimi.ai -> Console -> API Keys. China-platform keys need the Moonshot China provider.

moonshot_cn.manualEntryHint: Paste your Moonshot China open-platform API key from platform.kimi.com (formerly platform.moonshot.cn) -> Console -> API Keys.

minimax.manualEntryHint: Paste your MiniMax Coding Plan API key (sk-cp-...) from platform.minimax.io -> User Center -> Interface Key. China keys need the MiniMax China provider.

minimax_cn.manualEntryHint: Paste your MiniMax China Coding Plan API key from platform.minimaxi.com -> User Center -> Interface Key.

openai.manualEntryHint: Create a read-only Admin API key at platform.openai.com -> Settings -> Organization -> Admin keys and paste it. Regular project keys (sk-proj-...) are rejected by the billing endpoint.

github.manualEntryHint: Create a fine-grained token at github.com -> Settings -> Developer settings with Account -> Plan (read) permission, and enter it together with your GitHub username. Org-managed Copilot seats report empty usage.

xai.manualEntryHint: Create a Management Key with billing read access at console.x.ai -> Settings -> Management Keys and enter it with your team ID (visible in console URLs).

zai.manualEntryHint: Paste your GLM Coding Plan API key from z.ai -> Manage API Key. Experimental: the quota endpoint is undocumented and its schema may drift.

cursor.manualEntryHint: On cursor.com while signed in, open DevTools -> Application -> Cookies, copy the WorkosCursorSessionToken value, and paste it here. Experimental: undocumented web API; re-paste when the session expires.

kimi_code.manualEntryHint: Paste your Kimi Code API key (sk-kimi-...) from kimi.com/code/console. This coding-plan key is separate from a Moonshot open-platform key.
